# El8 Tech (Elite Tech Solutions)

> Elite Iraqi development team building rapid, state-of-the-art tech solutions: Interactive STEM Virtual Labs (Chemistry, Physics, Biology), Digital Academy Platforms, Full-Stack Web Apps, Desktop (.EXE), Mobile (.APK), Data Systems, and Hardware Integrations.

## Executive Overview
El8 Tech is a high-performance software and hardware engineering group based in Iraq. We deliver enterprise-grade digital systems, interactive educational simulations for schools and universities, custom AI models, and real-time data processing with unmatched engineering velocity.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Interactive Educational Labs & STEM Simulations
- Custom 60 FPS interactive virtual labs for **Chemistry, Physics, and Biology**.
- Tailored digital learning environments for **K-12 Schools, Academies, Colleges, and Universities**.
- Real-time physics engines, chemical reaction simulations, and cell biology visualizers accessible via Web, Mobile, and Desktop.

### 2. Full-Stack Web & Academy Management Platforms
- High-concurrency academic & enterprise management platforms (e.g., Raqeem / HauzaOnline Platform).
- Zero-dependency Single Page Application (SPA) architectures with custom hash-routing and state persistence.
- Automated academic evaluation algorithms (50+50 grading system) and intelligent student promotion engines.
- Advanced database security: PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS), anti-duplication exam guards, and cryptographic re-take prevention.

### 3. Artificial Intelligence & Data Engineering
- Custom RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) infrastructure & vector search embeddings.
- Computer vision, object tracking, and OCR systems for automated document digitizing.
- Automated workflow integration & intelligent decision-support engines.

### 4. Desktop & Native Software Development
- Enterprise Windows desktop applications (.EXE) using C#/.NET, Electron, or Tauri.
- System-level automation, local database sync, and offline-first administrative software.

### 5. Mobile Application Development
- Cross-platform Android (.APK) and iOS applications.
- Real-time notifications, location tracking, and mobile database synchronization.

### 6. Hardware & IoT Systems
- Custom embedded systems & 32-bit microcontroller integration (Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi).
- POS system hardware bridging, barcode/RFID scanners, and IoT sensor telemetry.

## Featured Case Studies & Projects
- **Raqeem / HauzaOnline Digital Academy System**: Scalable digital academy management platform featuring automated grading, anti-cheating exam security, and native RTL Arabic localization.
- **STEM Interactive Virtual Labs**: High-performance interactive laboratory simulations covering Chemistry, Physics, and Biology for educational institutions.
